geeklist.title: Cyber Week Auction - Discount Shipping (over $100) MD/DC/VA Local
geeklist.description:
[Center][size=24][b]**Cyber Week Auction 2025** [/b][/size] [size=12]Some of the Lowest Prices on BGG - Desperately Need to Downsize - Bundle Discounts Grab some last minute gifts or snag some new cardboard and plastic to play with over the holidays [/size]
[size=14][i][b][BGCOLOR=#FFFF00]DISCOUNTED SHIPPING OVER $100** Quick and Discounted shipping on Combined Purchases over $100** **($20 shipping discount per $100, Continental US). Please Inquire if you are located out West of the Mississsippi - CA, ID, WA, OR are usually a obscenely high[/BGCOLOR]
Bundles are encouraged. If you have a few games you like, shoot me a message and I can give you a bundle price offer.
In this round of games, we have everything from deluxe upgrade kits to epic Kickstarter All-Ins. I usually have a little something for most everyone.[/size]
[Size=10]All games should be considered used in like new condition unless noted otherwise. Many stock 'inserts' have been removed and most expansions/promos etc are included in the base box where possible. Inquire if needed.[/b][/i][/size]
Shipping is from [i][b]La Plata, MD 20646[/i][/b] to Continental USA only. Inquire about shipping costs for purchases - [i][b]USPS[/i][/b] preferred when possible. UPS Ground for larger/heavier packages. I can ship out BIN's the next day after receiving payment.[/Center]
[center]:colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist::colonist:[/center]
[size=15][b]RULES OF THE AUCTION:[/b][/size]
[size=11]:bd6-1: The auction will end sometime around/after 10 PM EST on [b][BGCOLOR=#FFFF00]Sunday, December 7, 2025.[/BGCOLOR][/b] Individual items receiving a bid on the evening of close (7pm on) may remain open past bid close for active bidders to prevent sniping. Usually until around noon the following day (depending on the bidding, at my sole discretion). Please be sure to subscribe to the items and check-in Monday morning if you have bid to ensure that listing has been closed or take note of late bids.
:bd6-2: In order for BGG to monitor their commission, all sales will be reported through [i][b]BGG Marketplace / GeekMarket[/b][/i] when possible.
:bd6-3: Actual shipping costs will be calculated [b]AFTER[/b] the end of the auction for [b]non-BIN[/b] items. I can give an estimate if you list your zip with your bid and send me a Geekmail. BIN games will be shipped prior to the end of the auction if requested. I generally use PirateShip for my shipping unless there is an abmormal cost (Crokinole Board 2022) **See Shipping Note Above**
:bd6-4: Payment through [i][b]PayPal / Venmo / CashApp / Zelle[/b][/i] only unless you pick up locally then cash is okay.
:bd6-5: If you are relatively close by and wish to pick up the game from me in person, that can also be arranged. I am located in [i][b]La Plata[/b][/i] and work daily in the [i][b]St Mary's / Mechanicsville[/b][/i] area. This method will be based on availability and sale price (typically $40 minimum outside of Southern Maryland). Please inquire if you would like pickup. Will travel for larger orders.
:bd6-6: Listings may be removed, cancelled or altered at any time during the auction. If an item description needs to be updated during the auction, any current bidders will be notified immediately to confirm bid. If bid cannot be confirmed in this instance, the listing may be removed for convenience.[/size]
[b][size=11]* NOTE 1: Very open to reduced shipping costs and BIN discounts for multiple items - feel free to inquire. ** NOTE 2: Trades can be entertained but not ideal. [url=https://tinyurl.com/wrv7z3w]Here is my wishlist....[/url] *** NOTE 3: Bids under starting bid will be removed without notice. **** NOTE 4: Once a bid has been placed, BIN pricing may be removed from the listing at my discretion. ***** NOTE 5: Many items may also available for BIN currently listed on the Marketplace at the prices listed.[url]https://boardgamegeek.com/market/user/jcrampton?pageid=1[/url] ****** NOTE 6: Please DM any inquiries. Any non-bids in comment section will likely be removed.[/size][/b]
[center][size=22][b]BE SAFE, GAME HARD, HAVE FUN [/b][/size][/center]

Pickup and deliver passengers around the US while navigating obstacles and grabbing bonuses. With everyone playing at the same time, passengers can be passed between players to maximize efficiency Oops, didn't get a passenger to their destination? They will grow angrier and cost you. [size=11] [b]STARTING BID:[/b] [COLOR=#990000]$20[/COLOR] [b]BIN:[/b] [COLOR=#990000]$30[/COLOR]
[size=11][/size][b][i]Fun hidden traitor/deduction game where each player assumes a role on a speeding train. Control the train speed and help guide the train to meet your characters hidden objective whether it be a maximum speed record, take the scenic route, cause a collision, etc. Plays great with 4+.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/brendanmills/stop-the-train/description
[/b][/i][/size]

[size=11] [b]STARTING BID:[/b] [COLOR=#990000][-]$350[/-] $275[/COLOR] [b]BIN:[/b] [COLOR=#990000]$300[/COLOR]
[size=11][/size][b][i]Kickstarter Exclusive Edition Street Fighter: The Miniatures Game by Jasco w/ Extras.
These are quite possibly the best pre-painted miniatures that I have come across in a game. You can tell that much love was put into the sculpts, rules and artwork. Each mini has it's own custom base along with numerous translucent/transparent effects.
This collection contains the impossible to get KS Stretch Goals Box with an additional 13 Fighters/Cards/Etc. This Stretch Goals Box also contains the Car Bash Bonus Round and the Capcom Cup Campaign Rules & Trophy mini.
The map pack contains map tiles and 3-D terrain for Balrog, Vega, Dhalsim & E.Honda.
This set is a definite must-have for any SFII fan or even minis fan. Pull up some more pics and you won't be disappointed.
